title: The Stasis Lantern Shop
description: A detailed storefront of a magical shop named 'The Stasis Lantern - Spells & Bindings' built into a red brick building. The blue wooden facade features a large bay window displaying scrolls, potion bottles, and a mechanical bird-like creature, with multiple sale signs advertising 'Locked Fusion Sale' on the cobblestone street.
